description: Bit-accurate emulation of NVIDIA tensor-core FP8 GEMM numerics for PyTorch: the bits of torch._scaled_mm on a reference GPU (RTX 4060, cuBLASLt 12.8.3.14), computed on a CPU or another CUDA GPU.
rules: mmaemu.scaled_mm takes the arguments of torch._scaled_mm (torch 2.7.1): input [M, K] FP8 row-major, mat2 [K, N] FP8 column-major (w.t() of a row-major [N, K] weight), and one-element fp32 scales.
Pass use_fast_accum as a Python bool; mmaemu.accumulate has no default for it.
Compare results bit for bit with mmaemu.testing.assert_bitwise_equal, not with torch.allclose or float equality.

SplitKUnknownError means the reference GPU's split-K decision for the shape is not known: pass splitk=1 or splitk=(S, 'serial' | 'pairwise') if it is, and use mmaemu.explain to see the split-K decision and backend of a call.
v0.1 reproduces one reference platform (RTX 4060, cuBLASLt 12.8.3.14); bias, row-wise scales and, under grad mode, inputs that require grad raise instead of being approximated.
